title: How fast does each thing move?
prompt: Place each one by its typical speed, slowest to fastest.

items.label: A walking person
items.fact: A comfortable walking pace is about 5 km/h — a kilometer every 12 minutes.

items.label: A cyclist cruising
items.fact: A fit rider holds around 30 km/h on the flats.

items.label: An Olympic sprinter
items.fact: Usain Bolt hit a peak of about 44 km/h mid-race.

items.label: A galloping racehorse
items.fact: Thoroughbreds sustain roughly 65 km/h over a race.

items.label: A car on the highway
items.fact: A typical highway limit — about 68 mph.

items.label: A commercial jet cruising
items.fact: Airliners cruise near 900 km/h, just below the speed of sound.
